mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_gateways ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_gateways (id, name, display_name, enabled, connected, config, last_four_digits, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{enabled}, #{connected}, #{config, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{lastFourDigits}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_gateways SET name = #{name}, display_name = #{displayName}, enabled = #{enabled}, connected = #{connected}, config = #{config, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, last_four_digits = #{lastFourDigits}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
